method: Mean-cycle educational estimate using a fixed 29.530588-day synodic month from Julian Day 2451550.2597 (2000-01-06 18:14 UTC). Selected wall time is converted with the stated fixed UTC offset. Primary-phase times can differ from authoritative ephemerides by many hours; do not use for navigation, tides, eclipses, or precise observing.
